editing_basis: Resize the complete original 1536x864 BGR screenshot once to 2322x1306 using bilinear interpolation. Crop at the existing event canvas; preserve complete two-option titles and one-pixel original-derived edges using alpha only; exclude descriptions, borders and decoration. RGB equals the explicitly interpolated source crop, not an unscaled baseline capture.
resampling_authorization: User explicitly selected using the existing smaller screenshot to produce a candidate after being told it requires upsampling to baseline and validation.

mask.method: HSV V>130, S<105 seed within two title windows, dilate 3x3 once; existing RGB preserved after resampling

agent_visual_review: Both complete titles compared at source 3x and candidate 2x; punctuation, dark strokes, internal holes and edges inspected.
selected_route: right: 收起撕裂的地图，离开这里。; text then original-floor map; no exploration experience on chosen route
limitations: Only one real 1536x864 capture exists for the new initial-title variant; it is also the candidate extraction source.
2322x1306, 1920x1080, 2304x1296 and 2560x1440 positives for the new variant are synthetic resizes of that same capture, not independent game renders.
The independent historical baseline capture validates the old variant and the shared right title only; it does not establish a real baseline positive for the new left title.
Offline linear enlargement is explicitly user-authorized and introduces interpolated RGB; no sharpening or AI redrawing was applied.
Repeated offline observations use copies of a saved image, not three newly captured game frames.
No live game input/capture. Candidate pixels unchanged after user image approval; tested 0.92/0.80 configuration is enabled by the subsequent registration/binding step.
approval_message: 可以通过审核，但是颜色门槛应该下降至0.92，你觉得可以吗
